title: Chapter 1325
text:
Boom!

Lightning bolts shot out crazily, circling around Han Xiao like dragons.

The mechanical spear changed its direction and turned into a thick bolt of lightning. It pierced out again and attacked another red God avatar that was wearing armor and holding a shield.

This red God Incarnation was restrained by the Apostle Weapon and could not dodge in time. It hurriedly put up a defensive posture and knocked the side of the shield with its war hammer. The surface of the shield immediately glowed, and the image of a shield-like shield popped out, magnified thousands of times, blocking in front of it.

Crack!

The heavy spear crashed into the shield, and the seemingly indestructible shield instantly shattered into pieces. The shockwave instantly spread out, as if there was a glass shattering explosion in everyone's mind.

A beam of light shot out from the tip of the spear, and with one strike, half of the body of this God Incarnation was swept away!

At this time, Wuornos flashed over from afar. He focused his strength on one point and elbowed the tip of the spear to avoid causing more damage. He then pulled the heavily injured God Incarnation aside and saved it.

Wuornos sized up Han Xiao again. Feeling the energy fluctuations of the Mechanical Deity, a complicated look flashed through his eyes.

"This is your full strength? Looks like I still underestimated you … No, I should say that you're too secretive. Just like the rumors, no one knows how many trump cards you have and where your limits are. "

"Why haven't I heard of this rumor?" Han Xiao casually replied.

In the past few days, he had been fighting with the direct members of the three Universal Civilizations. He had been suppressing his impulse and holding onto the Character Summon Card without using it, just to guard against Wuornos.

Wuornos could invite a god to possess him, and he also had a Character Summon Card with similar functions.

At this time, he had already activated the dual Mechanical Sense and dual Ancient Ones, and his strength had skyrocketed. He instantly entered his explosive state.

If he activated the Character Summon Card in advance, the direct members of the three Universal Civilizations would probably not be able to last six days. Even if they could, the number of direct Beyond Grade As who would fall in his hands would be much higher.

"A hundred years is just the blink of an eye. To a Beyond Grade A, it's at most their youth, but you already have the ability to dominate the galaxy at such a young age … In known history, no one has ever had a talent like yours. I really can't imagine how bright your future will be."

Wuornos sighed. He took out the last few Divinities, formed them into God Incarnations, and scattered to join the battle, using their own abilities to fight the mechanical army.

He had brought more than ten Divinities with him this time, and he originally did not want to use the rest. However, the current situation, he had no choice.

"Only a few? I'm afraid they won't be enough for me to kill. "Han Xiao raised his brows.

These God Incarnations had different abilities, and although they were high-level Beyond Grade As, they were relatively, they were relatively fragile.

His combat strength in his explosive state had already surpassed the common sense of ordinary people. As long as the God Incarnations did not have any special abilities or talents in defense, evasion, or recovery, he could easily kill them in a few seconds. It was much easier than dealing with those direct Beyond Grade As who had all kinds of Universal Treasures protecting them.

"I'll know after I try."

Wuornos put his hands together, and his body suddenly expanded, rapidly becoming a giant. Compared to Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity's size earlier, it was like an ant compared to a mountain, but now, it was on par with Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity.

However, the priest robe on his body was not torn apart. It expanded along with his body size, and dense magic circuits lit up on its surface. It was also a Universal Treasure level enchanted equipment, so he would not be naked in front of the entire universe.

This guy can grow bigger?

Han Xiao's eyes flickered. This was something that was not shown in the intelligence.

As if seeing Han Xiao's doubts, Wuornos slowly explained, "My God's Trait Transformation has been completed, and the giant bloodline can be used to the extreme. This is also the first time I'm using this ability."

He had been training in the Arcane Church for many years, and because the Ethereal National Treasure and his own ability happened to be related to 'divinity', his God's Trait Transformation was countless times smoother than other peak Beyond Grade As. He had completed two God's Trait Transformation routes long ago, but he had never told anyone.

Wuornos had a part of the giant bloodline to begin with, and the God's Trait Transformation of the race route greatly strengthened his giant bloodline, turning him into the most optimal form. It was as if he had gathered all the advantages of the evolution route.

"You're really lucky. Not only are your abilities compatible, but you've also received the full support of Ethereal."

Han Xiao frowned.

This b * stard was probably also a protagonist type character, and he most likely had the Advanced Luck Glow. He had kept a low profile for countless years, and he also hid his strength like a monk sweeping the floor.

He looked down at Wuornos' empty hands and said, "Are you planning to keep fighting me barehanded?"

Hearing this, Wuornos was silent for a while before sighing.

"… My weapon has already been sealed by you."

Han Xiao was stunned for a moment before understanding.

F * ck, so the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was also this b * stard's equipment!

To be specific, Wuornos only shared the right to use it. The Ten Thousand Deity Scepter still belonged to the Arcane Church, and it was usually used as a strategic deterrent. Unfortunately, it was sealed by the Spacetime Amber.

That made sense. The mechanism of this Universal Treasure was also compatible with Wuornos' abilities, so it was not strange for Ethereal to be used by him … However, he did not have the chance to use it now.

At this time, the fake Mechanical Deity finally returned to the battlefield along the path of the fleet formation. It continued to pounce over fearlessly, relying on its recovery ability.

Han Xiao twisted his body, and the mechanical spear quickly transformed into a whip. He swung it backward, and lightning exploded in the sky, dazzling everyone.

In its explosive state, the speed and strength of the Mechanical Deity had increased tremendously. This time, it struck the fake Mechanical Deity's waist at lightning speed, almost cutting it in half. At the same time, the fake Mechanical Deity was knocked to the side and sent flying away again.

At this time, a scorching energy came from behind. Han Xiao turned around and blocked Wuornos' fist with his spear.

Boom!

A shockwave burst out!

The two sides clashed with each other. Han Xiao's thrusters were at full power, and he had the upper hand, slowly pressing toward Wuornos.

"The giant bloodline is very strong. Your strength is no weaker than a Pugilist's." Han Xiao snorted.

"Same to you."

Wuornos suddenly retracted his fist and gathered his strength. The next moment, he threw out a sky full of fist shadows. When a tortoise's fist was extremely fast, no move was better than a move.

Han Xiao was not to be outdone. The mechanical spear spun as if it was flying, accurately meeting every attack. He fought with Wuornos, and a series of shockwaves exploded in the air.

At this time, the fake Mechanical Deity flew back and joined the battle. It was constantly sent flying, but it kept charging, persevering.

Wuornos had the Ethereal National Weapon to protect him, and the fake Mechanical Deity had inherited his super recovery ability. Currently, the only breakthrough on the battlefield was the other God Incarnations. Han Xiao planned to do the same, but he was blocked by the two giant bodies, so he had no choice but to take the attacks head-on and kill the God Incarnations.

At this point, there were no more tricks. The two sides fought head-on without stopping. The scene was intense, and the aftermath was shocking. The battle had already reached its climax.

Watching the news broadcast, the hearts of countless galactic residents were in their throats. They could not take their eyes off the screen.

"What a strong Beyond Grade A. He must be the trump card of the three Universal Civilizations!"

"God, please let Black Star lose … This is probably our last hope."

Many galactic residents could not help but pray.

On the other hand, contrary to the public opinion online, the players were excited.

"Oh, I'm familiar with this domain. The boss has entered the second stage!"

"Clear the mobs first before fighting the boss. Old Black did the right thing."

"Does anyone want to bet? I bet thirty thousand Enas on Old Black winning. Who wants to follow? "

The many army players discussed excitedly. The forums were already flooded with videos of the monsters on the scene. After flipping through more than ten pages, they were all clips of Han Xiao's battles in the past few days.

In the main ship of the three Universal Civilizations, many direct Beyond Grade As looked at the battlefield outside the window silently. Many of them had bitter expressions.

"I didn't expect Black Star to still hold back against us … If he had displayed such strength before, many people in this room would have stopped breathing." Verena smiled bitterly.

Hearing this, many Beyond Grade As turned to look at her, feeling even worse.

They originally thought that they were in a stalemate with Black Star, but the truth was that they had overestimated themselves. Not only were they exhausted, they even had to thank the other party for not using his full strength …

Thinking of such a situation, everyone's mood remained low, and their confidence was severely damaged.

Oulou held it in for a long time before he finally said something.

"Two monsters!"

Even as a peak Beyond Grade A, Oulou had to admit that these two were so strong that they made his heart tremble. Not only was Black Star shockingly strong, but Wuornos was also stronger than many years ago. The two of them had already surpassed the others. In his eyes, they were completely unique existences.

This time, Guzar frowned and said, "There's only two days left.

"There are only two days left before the ultimatum expires. Are we really going to let them fight one on one and just watch from the side?"

Hearing this, Clottey said solemnly, "Of course not.

"Of course not! When the time is almost up, we'll swarm in together. Ignore Wuornos. No matter what, we have to beat Black Star down. Now, hurry up and recover. If Wuornos still hasn't finished the battle by tomorrow, we'll have to attack again. "

Everyone's heart trembled as they nodded.

…

Time flew by quickly. Under everyone's gazes, Han Xiao and Wuornos fought fiercely for more than a day, and the situation gradually became clear.

Han Xiao finally eliminated all the God Incarnations other than the fake Mechanical Deity, paying the price of a large number of mechanical troops.

Although he was entangled by Wuornos and the fake Mechanical Deity, the explosive state of Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity gave him a significant advantage in terms of individual attributes. He broke through the encirclement time and time again, not caring about being injured at all. He got rid of the God Incarnations one after another, making it easier and easier for him.

In fact, the last few God Incarnations were not eliminated by him personally but by the mechanical troops and Apostle Weapons. Now, the remaining mechanical troops were free to attack Wuornos and the fake Mechanical Deity.

Clang!

The two of them clashed again, and Wuornos suddenly retreated a distance. He swung his hand and sent an Apostle Weapon that kept attacking his eyeballs flying.

"The God Incarnations I brought were all killed by you. It seems like I can't do anything to you."

"What, you're out of moves?"

Han Xiao slapped the fake Mechanical Deity away again and snorted.

"… There's only the two of us left. If we continue fighting like this, we won't be able to determine the winner." Wuornos shook his head.

"Anyway, there's only one day left. I don't care."

Han Xiao did not care.

Although he had killed all the God Incarnations, he could not break the Ethereal Nation Weapon, nor could he kill the fake Mechanical Deity. Wuornos could not threaten his life either. Now, it was just two big lumps of meat rubbing against each other. I can't kill you, and you can't kill me.

Conservatively speaking, he and Wuornos could still fight for ten days to half a month without rest.

"If that's the case, let's end it here," Wuornos said softly.

"You think it'll end just because you say so?" Han Xiao curled his lips.

Wuornos glanced at him and suddenly chuckled. His giant body suddenly shrank and returned to his normal size. He opened the public channel and said straightforwardly, "I'm not your match.

"I'm no match for you. I admit defeat."

Han Xiao was stunned. He did not expect Wuornos to do this.

A direct Beyond Grade A was standing up for the three Universal Civilizations. Admitting defeat in public would go against his original intention. Furthermore, neither of them showed any signs of losing. At most, it would be a draw. Why would he admit defeat on purpose?

Wuornos snapped his fingers, and the fake Mechanical Deity suddenly stopped and exploded from the inside out. This God Spirit Incarnation was directly removed by him.

Han Xiao frowned. He raised his hand to stop the mechanical army's attack and asked in confusion,

"… What are you doing?"

Wuornos turned off the wide area channel and switched back to mental communication. His eyes had a meaningful look.

"Black Star, you're the most talented Super to date. You're the most likely to open the door to the next level. I said from the beginning that I don't want to be your enemy."

"What do you mean by that? Admitting defeat in public, aren't you afraid that the Arcane Church will have something to say to you? "Han Xiao's brows furrowed even tighter.

"I've already done what I can, and it's enough to complete the mission. As for my purpose … maybe one day, you'll know."

Wuornos revealed an inexplicable smile, turned around, and flew toward the three Universal Civilizations' fleet.

Han Xiao made the mechanical army open a path and did not stop him. He silently stared at Wuornos' back and realized that he did not understand Wuornos' personality and thoughts.

In his previous life, the Dark Emperor and Oulou both died in the World Tree War. Only Wuornos did not participate in the war. Han Xiao did not believe that the Arcane Church did not give the order. He had no idea what this guy was thinking.

"… Forget it, I can't guess what he's thinking. Anyway, I've got the mission reward."

Han Xiao exhaled, opened the interface, and looked. A satisfied smile appeared on his face.

The Beyond Grade A Challenge Mission that belonged to Wuornos was shining with a golden light, showing the 'Completed' status.

He retracted his mechanical army, removed the Mechanical Deity, and sat on a new divine throne. He scanned the three Universal Civilizations' fleet, opened the public channel, and slowly spoke.

"Who else?"

As soon as he said that …

The entire channel was silent, not a single sound could be heard.

…

On the other side, as soon as Wuornos returned to the main ship, many direct Beyond Grade As surrounded him with unfriendly expressions.

"How can you admit defeat in public?!" Clotti shouted in a deep voice.

"I can't beat him, so of course, I have to admit defeat," Wuornos replied casually.

"Do you think we're blind?" Verena was furious. "You clearly don't show any signs of losing. You can continue to fight with Black Star for a long time!"

Wuornos glanced at her and said calmly, "And then? Are we going to fight until the end of the ultimatum? I remember that I said I wanted to fight Black Star one on one, but you guys don't plan to listen to my request and are ready to attack, right? "

Hearing this, everyone's momentum was stifled.

"I can guess what you guys are thinking with my eyes closed."

Seeing this, Wuornos shook his head, squeezed through the crowd, and walked away, leaving only his back view.

He did not want to participate in the battle from the beginning. Originally, he wanted to slack off until the end, but the Ethereal Pope had given a death order, so he had no choice but to take action.

However, Wuornos' mentality was not to defeat Black Star. He just wanted to see and experience Black Star's true strength and try his best. It would be enough if he could barely complete the mission.

He did not lie. He did admire Black Star a lot, but his motive for admitting defeat was not out of admiration but for another reason …

Wuornos did not want to stop the war between the three Universal Civilizations and the Beyond Grade A Association at all. Instead, he was happy to see it happen!

This was the core of the matter!

For so many years, Wuornos had been stuck at an invisible bottleneck. He realized that no matter what, it was difficult for his strength to increase. It was as if there was some kind of restriction that prevented him from touching a higher level of power.

He had always believed that only competition and pressure could give birth to the strong. Just like in the exploration era back then, when the Supers fought fiercely, the Beyond Grade As were born. The appearance of the first Primordial One was like a signal, and more Beyond Grade As appeared one after another.

The way he saw it, the advancement of individual strength might require a pioneer who was blessed by the heavens to break the limit. Only then would the latecomers be able to follow and drink the soup.

Black Star, who had broken the historical record, entered his sights because of this. In his eyes, Black Star was the most likely person to become a pioneer.

Wuornos did not like the harmonious atmosphere of the Beyond Grade A Association. He preferred to see the Beyond Grade As fight every day, just like raising venomous insects to give birth to stronger individuals. Now that the three Universal Civilizations were attacking the association, it was more in line with his needs.

In this regard, Wuornos and EsGod had the same stubbornness, but they walked different paths. Compared to EsGod's selfish style, Wuornos hoped that all the strong individuals in the universe would work together. To put it in a more fashionable way, he hoped to see an era where everyone was like a dragon and let others be the pioneers.

After all, with his ability, doing this would be twice the result with half the effort. The more strong individuals there were in the universe, the higher his peak combat strength would be.

Various thoughts flashed through his mind, and Wuornos lowered his eyes.

"Today, I'll give you my reputation. Let me see how far you can go."

…

At the same time …

The scene of Wuornos admitting defeat in public fell into the eyes of countless people through the news broadcast.

At this moment, the hope that countless galactic residents had finally ignited seemed to have been extinguished by a pool of urine. They felt cold from head to toe.

All the galactic residents who were looking forward to Black Star's defeat withered in their seats, their faces filled with despair.

The three Universal Civilizations were so huge, yet they could not find a single strong individual who could defeat Black Star. They even shamelessly ganged up on him and lost.

How embarrassing!

Not long after, countless galactic residents became nervous again. This was because today was the last day of the three Universal Civilizations' ultimatum. If both sides still did not give in, the war would most likely start!

Seeing that there was no hope, many galactic residents no longer hesitated. With the thought of giving up, they began to vent their anxiety and fear on the internet, as well as their anger that Black Star did not lose 'according to their wishes'.

All of a sudden, the public opinion supporting the three Universal Civilizations was stirred up again. They no longer called for a stop to the war but instead went to the other extreme. To a certain extent, they became fanatics supporting the war. The core argument was only one … they strongly supported the three Universal Civilizations to defeat the Beyond Grade A Association and eliminate the unstable factors in the galactic society!

She was reborn as the abandoned daughter of a concubine, solved the case, started her career, entered the organization, went to the central government, and took revenge for her father!
